summary: Biomimetic enamel repair. A fluoride-free paste that utilizes the exact mineral makeup of human teeth to remineralize micro-cavities and eliminate sensitivity.
description: Structural dental engineering. This advanced formula bypasses traditional fluoride, instead deploying nano-sized hydroxyapatite particles that physically bond to the tooth structure, rebuilding the enamel from the outside in.
technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 100g, this KoColor TOOTHPASTE is expertly formulated with Nano-Hydroxyapatite, Xylitol, and Peppermint Oil. It delivers a high-fidelity Mint White color profile (`#F5FFFA`) and leverages biomimetic enamel synthesis.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Brush thoroughly for 2 minutes, twice daily.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Do not rinse with water after brushing; spit only. Leaving the residue on the teeth maximizes the remineralization process overnight.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Xylitol actively starves Streptococcus mutans (the primary bacteria responsible for tooth decay) by inhibiting their ability to process sugars.
